scientific_integrity: Analytic local expansion on C8 embedded strictly convex closed curves; fully derived fifth-order curvature-gradient term. The first nontrivial curvature correction has relevant existing literature; only the fifth-order formula and frequency transition are presented as candidate new contributions.
scientific_limitations: No full historical uniqueness certification. Curvature must be strictly positive, arclength sample independent, t->0 before varying harmonic frequency. No uniform high-frequency remainder, no finite-sample inference. A directly relevant 2005 paper contains a second-order kernel expansion; the higher-order term is not supplied there.
title: Fifth-order small-chord law and a sharp curvature-frequency transition for convex plane curves
